scope: Seven source-informed CLI acceptance controls, not a new blind batch or independent scientific calibration.
requirements: Verify actual own build job checkout, tested commit parents/tree, successful steps and artifact API/upload identity.
Freeze actual artifact ZIP digest, binary digest, captured Cargo.lock digest and receipt association before executing any control.
Execute each original script once in a new result directory; preserve stdout, stderr, exit, timeout and resource refusal.
Verify typed boundary refusal and inventory preservation from ignition rows; distinguish permitted heating/phase changes from chemical inventory changes.
Preserve first control failures/inconclusive conditions before any versioned correction.
Do not borrow faaf4baf or original main b290 binaries for this source.
